description: Defines the ProxyConfigServiceMac class responsible for managing proxy configuration on Mac OS, including observing system settings and notifying observers of changes.

classes.name: ProxyConfigServiceMac
classes.description: Manages proxy configuration on Mac OS, observing system settings and notifying registered observers.

classes.name: ProxyConfigServiceMac::Forwarder
classes.description: Delegates network configuration change notifications from NetworkConfigWatcherMac to ProxyConfigServiceMac.

methods.name: ProxyConfigServiceMac
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the service with a task runner and traffic annotation.

methods.name: AddObserver
methods.description: Registers an observer to be notified of proxy configuration changes.

methods.name: SetDynamicStoreNotificationKeys
methods.description: Sets notification keys for system proxy settings changes.

methods.name: OnProxyConfigChanged
methods.description: Notifies observers of a change in proxy configuration.
